remarks: Step into The Jungle House at 550 Orange Ave, Unit 227 where urban energy meets a tranquil retreat. This recently-updated end-unit condo offers lush courtyard views, central AC and heat, in-unit laundry, and one (1) designated garage parking space, so you can still enjoy modern conveniences in the vibrant and walkable Alamitos Beach. The heart of the home is an open-concept layout where the kitchen, dining, and living areas flow together seamlessly - ideal for hosting friends or enjoying a quiet evening in.
